此工作流程允许您在 ComfyUI 中利用 FLUX.1 [dev] 的强大功能。请按照以下步骤设置并运行模型。

可以找到 Flux 工作流程的真正“最简单”版本这里，但它使用的是稍差一点的FP8版本。因此，我不使用工作流程的“加载检查点”节点版本。

注意：要训练 LoRA，请在此处观看我的视频指南：https://civitai.com/articles/6533/how-to-train-a-lora-for-flux1-dev-with-simpletuner

说明：

  1. 模型放置：

    • 将 FLUX.1 [dev] 检查点放置在ComfyUI/模型/unet（不在检查点文件夹中）

  2. 下载所需文件：

    • 原始重量：Flux1-dev.sft

    • FP8 版本（适用于 <24GB VRAM 系统）：Flux1-dev-fp8.safetensors

    • 文本编码器（放置在ComfyUI/模型/剪辑): Flux_text_encoders

    • VAE（地点ae.sft在ComfyUI/模型/vae): ae.sft

    • 对于较低的 RAM 使用率，请下载 FP8 T5XXL 编码器（质量会有所下降）

  3. 低 VRAM 设置：

    • 使用“--lowvram”参数启动 ComfyUI（添加到您的 .bat 文件）以将文本编码器卸载到 CPU

  4. 性能说明：

    • 确认运行于：

      • RTX 3090 (24GB)：1.29 秒/它

      • RTX 4070 (12GB)：85 秒/它

    • 两项测试均使用 FP8 量化版本。请注意，4070 的速度要慢得多。

  5. 预览设置：

    • 将您的 ComfyUI 更新到最新版本

    • 在管理器菜单中，将“预览方法”设置为“自动”

使用工作流程

  1. 将提供的工作流程文件加载到 ComfyUI 中

  2. 根据需要调整提示和参数

  3. 运行工作流程以生成图像

注意：此工作流程包括元数据的自定义节点。它可以在普通 ComfyUI 中运行，但如果您没有安装此自定义节点，您可能需要调整工作流程。

FLUX.1 简介 [开发]

FLUX.1 [dev] 是一款突破性的 120 亿参数整流流量转换器，用于文本到图像生成，由 Black Forest Labs 开发。作为创新 FLUX.1 模型套件的一部分，它代表了图像合成技术的重大飞跃，提供：

  • 最先进的图像质量和及时的遵守

  • 与闭源替代方案的竞争性能

  • 通过指导蒸馏培训提高效率

  • 支持多种宽高比和分辨率（0.1 至 2.0 兆像素）

Black Forest Labs 由杰出的人工智能研究人员和工程师创立，带来了开发 VQGAN、潜在扩散和稳定扩散等基础生成人工智能模型的丰富经验。 FLUX.1 [dev] 展示了他们对突破人工智能生成图像界限的承诺。

许可和使用

FLUX.1 [dev] 是在非商业许可下发布的。请参考官方FLUX.1 [开发] 许可证了解完整的条款和条件。该模型仅供研究、个人项目和非商业用途。

通过这个 ComfyUI 工作流程享受探索 FLUX.1 [dev] 的功能！

o.en:
This workflow allows you to harness the power of FLUX.1 [dev] within ComfyUI. Follow these steps to set up and run the model.

The true "simplest" version of a Flux workflow can be foundhere, but it uses the FP8 version which is slightly worse. For that reason, I do not use the "Load Checkpoint" node version of the workflow.

Note: To train LoRAs, see my video guide here:https://civitai.com/articles/6533/how-to-train-a-lora-for-flux1-dev-with-simpletuner

Instructions:

  1. Model Placement:

    • Place the FLUX.1 [dev] checkpoint inComfyUI/models/unet(not in checkpoints folder)

  2. Download Required Files:

    • Original weights:flux1-dev.sft

    • FP8 version (for <24GB VRAM systems):flux1-dev-fp8.safetensors

    • Text encoders (place inComfyUI/models/clip): flux_text_encoders

    • VAE (placeae.sftinComfyUI/models/vae): ae.sft

    • For lower RAM usage, download the FP8 T5XXL encoder (with some quality degradation)

  3. Low VRAM Setup:

    • Launch ComfyUI with the "--lowvram" argument (add to your .bat file) to offload the text encoder to CPU

  4. Performance Notes:

    • Confirmed to run on:

      • RTX 3090 (24GB): 1.29s/it

      • RTX 4070 (12GB): 85s/it

    • Both tests used the FP8 quantized version. Note that the 4070 is significantly slower.

  5. Preview Setup:

    • Update your ComfyUI to the latest version

    • In the Manager menu, set "Preview Method" to "Auto"

Using the Workflow

  1. Load the provided workflow file into ComfyUI

  2. Adjust your prompts and parameters as desired

  3. Run the workflow to generate images

Note: This workflow includes a custom node for metadata. It can run in vanilla ComfyUI, but you may need to adjust the workflow if you don't have this custom node installed.

Introduction to FLUX.1 [dev]

FLUX.1 [dev] is a groundbreaking 12 billion parameter rectified flow transformer for text-to-image generation, developed by Black Forest Labs. As part of the innovative FLUX.1 suite of models, it represents a significant leap forward in image synthesis technology, offering:

  • State-of-the-art image quality and prompt adherence

  • Competitive performance with closed-source alternatives

  • Enhanced efficiency through guidance distillation training

  • Support for diverse aspect ratios and resolutions (0.1 to 2.0 megapixels)

Black Forest Labs, founded by distinguished AI researchers and engineers, brings a wealth of experience from developing foundational generative AI models like VQGAN, Latent Diffusion, and Stable Diffusion. FLUX.1 [dev] showcases their commitment to pushing the boundaries of AI-generated imagery.

License and Usage

FLUX.1 [dev] is released under a non-commercial license. Please refer to the officialFLUX.1 [dev] licensefor full terms and conditions. This model is intended for research, personal projects, and non-commercial use only.

Enjoy exploring the capabilities of FLUX.1 [dev] with this ComfyUI workflow!
